name: Defective Sample Report
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "Sample ID:Link/Soil Sample Collection:150", 
    status AS "Status:Data:100", 
    rejection_remarks AS "Remark:Text:200", 
    collection_date AS "Date:Date:120", 
    district_name AS "District:Data:150", 
    name_of_type AS "Scheme/Program Name:Data:200", 
    target_lab AS "Target Lab:Data:150",
    lab_name AS "Recieving Lab:Data:150"
FROM `tabSoil Sample Collection`
WHERE status = 'Rejected'
ORDER BY collection_date DESC
